research_question: Does instructor beauty affect teaching productivity as reflected in student instructional ratings?

ivs.description: Instructor physical attractiveness rating (main predictor of interest). Average beauty score from six judges, mean-centered.

dv.description: Course overall teaching evaluation score (outcome). Student instructional rating on a 1-5 scale.

controls.description: Instructor age (numeric) included as a control for experience/age-related effects.
Number of students who participated in the evaluation (numeric) controlling for sample size of the rating.
Total number of students enrolled in the course (numeric) controlling for course size.
Instructor gender (categorical) included as a control (factor variable).
Instructor minority status (categorical) included as a control (factor variable for non-Caucasian status).
Course credit type (categorical) indicating single-credit elective vs. other, included as a control.
Course division (categorical) upper vs lower division, included as a control.
Whether the instructor is a native English speaker (categorical) included as a control.
Instructor tenure status (categorical) indicating on tenure track or not, included as a control.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load data
path = 'teachingratings.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(path)

# Simple bivariate model
model_simple = smf.ols('eval ~ beauty', data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')

# Multivariate model with controls
formula = (
    'eval ~ beauty + age + students + allstudents '
    '+ C(gender) + C(minority) + C(credits) + C(division) + C(native) + C(tenure)'
)
model_controls = smf.ols(formula, data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')

results = {
    'simple_coef': model_simple.params['beauty'],
    'simple_pvalue': model_simple.pvalues['beauty'],
    'controls_coef': model_controls.params['beauty'],
    'controls_pvalue': model_controls.pvalues['beauty'],
    'simple_r2': model_simple.rsquared,
    'controls_r2': model_controls.rsquared,
    'n': int(model_controls.nobs),
}

print(results)
